push.title: L 3-4 vs Moisture FC | You: 9.0
push.body:
buddskees, a 9.0 against Moisture FC. You were a problem for them all night, the good kind.

THE GOOD
+ 29 passes (up from your usual 17). High involvement, high impact.
+ A hat trick against Moisture FC, your 3rd straight match scoring. Goals are like biscuits: always better shared, but I'll take this one.
+ Man of the Match, your 22nd for us. You set the bar, now the rest of us get to chase it.
+ Man of the Match in a losing side: the bright spot on a dark night. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.
+ 7th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's what showing up looks like.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Real talk: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes. Practice makes permanent.
- No key passes from 29 passes. Next match: Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
- Misplaced passes 7, up from your usual 4. Coach's tip: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- A promotion match, and we lost it. We win together and we wear this together.
- 4 goals conceded dropped you 0.2. Let's patch that.

Tonight's homework: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

buddskees, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: Hope is a plan with its shoes untied. Tie 'em.

Champions are made on nights like this. - Coach Lasso

BellyTb1, a 6.5. Go easy on yourself tonight; tomorrow we roll up our sleeves.

THE GOOD
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. Accuracy over ego. That's maturity.
+ You and buddskees linked up like peanut butter and jelly. Keep making sandwiches.
+ 3rd straight match at 80% pass accuracy. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.

- A promotion match, and we lost it. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 21 (best was buddskees's 29). One honest look at that and we move forward.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 1 (best was buddskees's 0). That's on the to-do list now.

! 0 goals from 2 on target. That one hurt the team, and the team deserves better. Mind this: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.

Training-ground special: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Every pro was once an amateur who didn't quit.

We'll sharpen it at practice. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 3-4 vs Moisture FC | You: 6.4
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 6.4 isn't who you are. It's one night. Let's figure out what it's trying to teach us.

THE GOOD
+ Tackle success 100%, up from your usual 29%. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ 3 shots at Moisture FC's goal. Fortune favors the folks who shoot.
+ You and buddskees combined like peanut butter and banana. Underrated and delicious.
+ Passes attempted 23, up from your usual 18. Proof you've got another gear.
+ 4 goals conceded gave a +0.2 boost.

THE BAD
- 65% passing (15 of 23, down from your usual 77%). Lesson of the day: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- Their best forward posted 8.6 to your 6.4. We'll drill that till it's boring.
- A promotion match, and we lost it. A team result, and it needs a team answer.
- 3 tackles won: -0.2. That's your quickest improvement.

THE UGLY
! 0 of 3 shots on target. Plain as a tractor: unacceptable. Quick one: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

Practice pointer: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

PhogsToffees, one more thing before you log off: You can't rush a good brisket or a good player.

Champions have off days too. - Coach Lasso
